claim_text: Spirulina and other blue-green algae products may be contaminated with microcystins or other contaminants; FDA and ANSES identify product quality, species identity, testing and vulnerable populations as relevant safety considerations.
health_goal_or_outcome: Product quality, contaminant exposure and safety

population.age_range: As specified in the underlying source; not generalized beyond studied populations.
population.health_status: Not a diagnosis or individualized treatment recommendation.
population.other_context: Claim scope restricted to the cited outcome and source population.

limitations: Spirulina (Arthrospira) must be distinguished from Aphanizomenon and other cyanobacteria.
A source registry entry does not certify an individual commercial batch.
Supplier certificates and independent batch testing are necessary for product-level assurance.
